title: Engine differential report
description: Operation-by-operation comparison of the read engines, returned as the differential member of vlab doctor --differential (CLI output; src/engine.js runDifferential). The probes must cover the read-operation catalog exactly.

oracle.description: The first engine; its results are the reference.

reason.description: Why a probe was skipped; present only for status 'skipped'.

results.description: Per-engine probe outcome keyed by engine name: digest (or null on error), error, processes, fallbacks, directReads.
